0022600187.text: The Orlando Magic (2-5, 12th in the East) visit the Phoenix Suns (1-5, 12th in the West) for the Magic's eighth game of the season and the Suns' sixth, with Orlando having lost its last two and Phoenix its last four. Orlando is 0-4 at home and 2-1 on the road, and it will be without Izaiyah Nelson, Jalen Suggs, Jonathan Isaac, Noah Penda and Paolo Banchero, while Phoenix is missing Jordan Goodwin, Mark Williams and Rasheer Fleming. The teams have not met yet this season, and they split their 2025-26 series 1-1, with Orlando's 115-111 win in Orlando on March 31, 2026 as the most recent meeting.
